items.difficulty_reason: The proof is a five-step iterated reduction driven by the smooth-covering spectral sequence: make $\mathcal{X}$ a scheme, then affine; make $\mathcal{Y}$ an algebraic space, then a scheme, then separated, then affine, each restart of the smooth-covering argument upgrading $\mathcal{Y}$ one step via the representability of diagonals (stack diagonal by algebraic spaces, space diagonal by schemes, scheme diagonal separated, separated diagonal affine), landing in assumption (4).
